title: Meerkats Task Router v1 — MECE intent taxonomy
description: Top of the DSL. Every request is exactly one task_type, drawn from seven intents across three families. This is the router that runs before schema-constrained generation; intent misclassification surfaces here. MECE: the root oneOf admits exactly one branch per task_type (mutually exclusive) and the seven branches are the complete set (collectively exhaustive). Composition: query_and_act tasks (query, action) ref query_and_act/v1; diagnosis refs diagnose_and_recommend/v1; simulation and recommendation are enveloped here; alert and workflow ref workflows_and_automations/v1. All cross-referenced schemas must be registered in the validator.

query_and_act.determinism: deterministic — one validated instance, no LLM pass

action_task.$comment: family: query_and_act — deterministic, WRITE. One of the only two mutating intents; carries the full execution_plan/approval machinery.

diagnosis_task.$comment: family: diagnose_and_recommend — read-only. Full request/result contract lives in diagnose_and_recommend/v1.

simulation_task.$comment: family: diagnose_and_recommend — read-only, projects forward. change absent = baseline forecast; change present = counterfactual. One intent, two modes.

change.description: the intervention being simulated. OMIT for a baseline forecast.

lever.description: what is changed, e.g. budget, bid

select.description: which entities the change applies to

recommendation_task.$comment: family: diagnose_and_recommend — read-only itself. EMITS proposals (each = selection + action + projected impact) that enter the approval queue; executes nothing.

objective.description: goal to optimize, e.g. improve_roas, reduce_cac

scope.description: entities the recommender may act over

constraints.description: bounds on the search, expressed in the same metric-predicate vocabulary as having

alert_task.$comment: family: workflows_and_automations — standing, read-only. Shape owned by workflows_and_automations/v1 (notify = slack|email channels).

workflow_task.$comment: family: workflows_and_automations — standing, WRITE. Shape owned by workflows_and_automations/v1; approval + tool binding enforced on its server artifacts (standing_config, workflow_run).
